name: Mizunashi Sorano
source: Kusuhara's now-deceased childhood friend. She normally has an easy, gentle personality, but sometimes shows a stubborn side to her as well. Kusuhara, Amamiya, and Sorano were always together wherever they went, and were best friends. However, Sorano lost her life just one month prior due to a traffic accident. According to the police report, she had thrown herself in front of a car, but Kusuhara refused to believe she would ever commit suicide. Determined, he decides to speak with Sorano's memories. The truth behind of her death is--
